warning: TEST KEYS ONLY. The private keys below are derived from public labels (seed = SHA-256 of "warrant-test-vector:<label>") and protect nothing. Never use them outside tests.
how_to_use: hashing: reproduce every hash and canonical form.
keys: Ed25519 private keys are base64 PKCS#8 DER (seed = last 32 bytes); public keys are base64 SPKI DER.
honest: re-sign the payloads with the keys and compare JWS strings (Ed25519 is deterministic).
verify: run your verifier on each bundle with its context; compare the outcome and the rules that reject or ask for review.
payer_binding, facts, outcome_table, ledger: reproduce the expected results. Each facts vector carries its own bundle, registry, wallet records and inputs.

text.input: Find a standing desk converter under $120

instruction.text: Find a standing desk converter under $120

verify.name: honest-human-present
verify.description: A well-formed warrant with human_present consent.

verify.name: honest-human-not-present
verify.description: A well-formed warrant under a mandate that allows human_not_present.

verify.name: v01-forged-cart-signature
verify.description: The cart is signed by a key the registry does not hold for that kid.

verify.name: v01-forged-mandate-signature
verify.description: The mandate is signed by a key other than the registered wallet key.

verify.name: v01-consent-reused-for-identical-cart-new-jti
verify.description: The agent signs a second cart warrant for exactly the same items under a fresh jti and nonce and reuses the consent. cart_hash is identical, but the consent signs the first warrant's jti, so it does not cover this one.

verify.name: v01-consent-for-other-merchant
verify.description: The consented cart is re-signed with another merchant as audience and presented to that merchant (so V04 passes). The consent signs the merchant the human saw, so it does not cover this warrant.

verify.name: v01-consent-from-0-1-bundle
verify.description: A 0.1-style consent (no cart_jti, no aud) in a 0.2 bundle: it cannot be decoded, so its key cannot be checked either.

verify.name: v01-consent-copied-from-another-cart
verify.description: The agent builds a different cart and pastes in the wallet consent signed for the approved cart. Even with a matching wallet record and catalog, the consent does not cover the new cart hash.

verify.name: v01-edited-mandate-scope
verify.description: The mandate payload is edited to raise the limits but the original wallet signature is kept.

verify.name: v01-unknown-kid
verify.description: The cart is signed under a kid that is not in the registry.

verify.name: v02-revoked-agent-key
verify.description: The agent platform key was revoked before now and before the cart was issued.

verify.name: v02-key-revoked-later-is-fine
verify.description: The agent key will be revoked in the future; the warrant is still valid now.

verify.name: v03-expired-mandate
verify.description: The mandate (and cart) are long expired.

verify.name: v03-expired-cart
verify.description: The cart warrant expired more than 60 seconds ago; the mandate is still valid.

verify.name: v03-within-skew
verify.description: The cart expired 60 seconds ago: still inside the allowed clock skew.

verify.name: v03-cart-lifetime-too-long
verify.description: The cart warrant claims a 901-second lifetime; the maximum is 900.

verify.name: v03-cart-issued-before-mandate-valid
verify.description: The cart was issued 100 seconds before the mandate became valid (more than the 60 second skew).

verify.name: v03-cart-issued-after-mandate-expired
verify.description: The cart was issued 61 seconds after the mandate expired.

verify.name: v03-mandate-issued-after-valid-from
verify.description: The mandate claims to have been issued one second after its not-before time.

verify.name: v04-other-merchant
verify.description: The warrant is addressed to a different merchant.

verify.name: v05-replayed-nonce
verify.description: The merchant has already seen this nonce.

verify.name: v05-replayed-jti-fresh-nonce
verify.description: The merchant has already seen this cart warrant jti, although the nonce is new: a consent signs one jti, so it cannot be spent twice.

verify.name: v06-mandate-hash-mismatch
verify.description: The cart references a different mandate hash than the mandate presented.

verify.name: v06-instruction-hash-mismatch
verify.description: The mandate instruction text was changed but instruction.hash still hashes the original request.

verify.name: v07-cart-hash-mismatch
verify.description: cart_hash is not the hash of the canonical cart object.

verify.name: v07-total-does-not-sum
verify.description: cart.total does not equal the sum of the lines (the hash was recomputed, so only the sum check catches it, and the catalog total disagrees too).

verify.name: v08-merchant-repriced
verify.description: The merchant catalog now prices the item higher than the cart.

verify.name: v08-unavailable
verify.description: The item is out of stock at the merchant.

verify.name: v09-total-above-max
verify.description: The cart total exceeds the mandate max_total.

verify.name: v09-merchant-denied
verify.description: The mandate denies this merchant.

verify.name: v09-category-not-allowed
verify.description: The mandate only allows books; the item is office furniture.

verify.name: v09-cumulative-total-exceeded
verify.description: 32.00 and one item were already bought under this cumulative mandate; 32.00 + 89.00 = 121.00 is above the 120.00 budget.

verify.name: v09-cumulative-items-exceeded
verify.description: Two items were already bought under this cumulative mandate (max 2); one more is over the item budget.

verify.name: v09-cumulative-exactly-at-limit
verify.description: 31.00 and one item already bought: 31.00 + 89.00 = 120.00 and 1 + 1 = 2 are exactly the budget, which is allowed.

verify.name: v09-cumulative-spend-unknown
verify.description: The spend under a cumulative mandate is unknown: the budget cannot be checked, so the verifier asks for review.

verify.name: v09-cumulative-not-configured
verify.description: The verifier is given no spend source for a cumulative mandate: review, never a silent pass.

verify.name: v09-per-cart-ignores-spend
verify.description: A per_cart mandate applies its limits to each cart separately; a huge recorded spend does not matter.

verify.name: v10-wallet-record-mismatch
verify.description: The wallet recorded a different screen for this cart than the consent claims.

verify.name: v10-wallet-record-for-other-jti
verify.description: The wallet only has a record for a different cart warrant jti. The record is looked up by jti, so it does not count.

verify.name: v10-human-required-but-absent
verify.description: The mandate requires a human_present consent; the cart claims human_not_present.

verify.name: v12-principal-over-limit
verify.description: The principal already has 3 warrants in the window (limit 3): review, not reject.

verify.name: v12-under-limit
verify.description: Velocity is configured and under both limits.

facts.name: facts-clean
facts.description: An honest warrant, an order that matches it, delivered on time. F1-F10 and F13 hold, nothing is refunded, 120 hours remain.

facts.name: facts-jti-used-twice
facts.description: The nonce was used once but the cart warrant jti was recorded twice: the consent was spent twice, so F8 is false.

facts.name: facts-nonce-used-twice
facts.description: The jti was used once but the nonce twice.

facts.name: facts-cumulative-over-budget
facts.description: When this cart was accepted 32.00 and one item were already spent under the cumulative mandate: 121.00 is above the 120.00 budget, so F6 is false.

facts.name: facts-cumulative-at-limit
facts.description: Exactly at the budget (31.00 + 89.00 = 120.00, 1 + 1 = 2 items): F6 holds.

facts.name: facts-cumulative-spend-unknown
facts.description: The spend recorded at acceptance is unknown. F6 is decided on the per-cart limits alone and says the cumulative check was not made; the agent platform is not blamed for what cannot be shown.

facts.name: facts-refunded
facts.description: A refund already exists for the capture: F11 is true.

outcome_table.note: F5 is true exactly when bundleCartMatchesConsent and orderMatchesBundleCart are both true. Only listed overrides differ from the defaults; an explicit F5 override wins.

tampered.description: The payload of entry 3 is edited; the stored hash no longer matches.
